Definition: Ephrajim, a son of Joseph; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
BiblicalUsage: Ephraim — I shall be doubly fruitful — is Joseph's second son, blessed by Jacob with his right hand over the younger. His name became the tribe's, and then the name of the whole northern kingdom in the prophets.
TheologicalSignificance: The blessing crossed hands, and the second son became the greater, because God gives as He wills and not as men expect. I believe Ephraim is the picture of God's freedom to choose the younger, and Joseph's joy at his fruitfulness was only the beginning.
RelatedPeople: Ephraim; Joseph, Son of Jacob; Jacob
